cause: Context Pack was frozen before development started.
impact: The line has an evidence-bound starting context.
lesson: Freeze the initial context before changing implementation state.

cause: The first formal control invocation used the shared virtual environment without explicitly placing this worktree backend first, so the CLI imported a different worktree's development-control module.
impact: The formal command did not inspect or mutate the line until the target backend was supplied explicitly.
lesson: Run formal control commands with the target worktree backend explicitly first when linked worktrees share a virtual environment.

cause: The first append attempt placed the temporary event source in the shared workspace root rather than the target linked worktree, so the formal CLI rejected the repository-relative source as unavailable.
impact: The append did not mutate the formal event log until the source was created inside the target worktree.
lesson: Provide repository-relative event source paths inside the target worktree to devline_control append.

cause: The focused statistical consumer suite still read unbound reports/report.html and asserted legacy sampling and Poisson fallback behavior after the typed report and fail-closed survey contracts were active.
impact: The intended typed consumer boundary was red while the production contracts remained unchanged.
lesson: Migrate presentation consumers to durable typed evidence while preserving model, diagnostic, weighting, offset, fallback, trace, and lineage behavior.

cause: The three statistical consumer tests were reviewed against the typed diagnostic/model/report-unavailable boundary without changing production code.
impact: Presentation assertions now consume durable typed evidence while weighting, model, offset, invalid-exposure, and fail-closed assertions remain active.
lesson: Keep presentation consumers on durable typed evidence and leave unbound Report unavailable.

cause: Final focused tests, in-memory compile, and diff check passed after the typed assertion migration.

evidence.ref: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=backend:tests .venv/bin/pytest -q --maxfail=1 tests/test_ols_weights_v186.py tests/test_orchestrator_e2e.py tests/test_p0_regression.py; compile; git diff --check

impact: 48 tests pass with five known statsmodels warnings; the three owned tests preserve typed statistical evidence and fail-closed unbound presentation.
lesson: A green consumer migration is admissible only when typed evidence and unbound Report unavailable are both asserted.

cause: The scoped typed statistical consumer migration met its focused test, compile, diff, and formal verification gates.
impact: The formal line is complete; only the three authorized tests and formal evidence are intended for commit.
lesson: Close a development line only after its typed consumer evidence and formal log verify together.
